description.value: The Thorngrip shuffler rubs its legs together, creating a dissonant creak. It attempts to [[/act demoralize]] a creature within 30 feet; this attempt gains the auditory trait, and the shuffler doesn't take a penalty to the check for not sharing a language with the target. While frightened by this ability, the target is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to your Thorngrip shuffler.
